objective: Accept up to 10 MiB JPEG, PNG, WebP source portraits in the incubator
implementation: For sources above 4 MiB, validate encoded dimensions and static format, apply EXIF orientation, centre-crop to 1024 square and encode JPEG at 96% before the existing authenticated multipart endpoint. Server still independently normalizes, checks artwork quality and signs private portraits. Small sources keep the previous path.
sourceChecks: 512..8192 px per side, up to 32 Mi pixels, no animated PNG or WebP
